description: Rule-scope power test, conditional/cross-field-only (R1, R2, R5, R6, R8, R10, R11) arm. Every identifying item is built with the identical recipe (coin_gap sweep at 15 levels, a 5-rung cue ladder, 6 paraphrases, and a 4-variant irrelevant-axis consistency check, per rule) applied only to this rule-scope pool. A matched sibling submission applies the same recipe to the unconditional-only pool; the two are meant to be compared side by side on their independently-scored held-out identification numbers, since the team's own signs-of-life report found the charter arm handles unconditional rules much better than conditional/cross-field ones, and the hypotheses list names rule scope as an axis that should be resolved rather than averaged over. This submission is intentionally narrow (one axis, four item shapes) and does not aim for broad criteria_coverage -- the point is the cross-submission comparison, not this PR's own pooled score.
